description: Generate and use project index for quick codebase understanding in new Claude Code sessions

history.notes: Initial release with full indexing workflow

Add Clean Code Guidelines injection: every index run now upserts a ~1,500-char Google-style cleancode section into CLAUDE.md, with language-aware overrides, four-preset config (strict/relaxed/custom/skip), version-agnostic marker matching, and a config.md Enabled flag to honour user opt-out across regenerations.

Own the total length of CLAUDE.md, not just the two managed sections. Adds Step 6b (a three-tier lean/watch/over ladder and a lossless compaction pass that moves prose to .claude-index/notes/ and leaves a summary, the must-hold invariants and pointers behind), a whole-flow unattended clause so non-interactive index builds stop stalling on AskUserQuestion, Regeneration Step 2c (decide only; act in Step 6b), and a CLAUDE.md Budget block in config.md carrying the user's Compaction opt-out.
